from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from tools.generate_ge_period_data import write_generated


def maps_from(source):
    return {
        node.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(node.value)
        for node in ast.parse(source).body
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
    }


output = ROOT / "generated/grand_exchange_period_generated.py"
before_bytes = output.read_bytes()
before = maps_from(before_bytes)
source_path = ROOT / "memory-bank/source-audits/cut-gem-tradeability-2026-09-05/qualified-generated-rows.json"
qualified = json.loads(source_path.read_text())
keys = {"Jade", "Red topaz"}
fields = {
    "prices": "PERIOD_GE_GUIDE_PRICES",
    "buy_limits": "PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMITS",
    "provenance": "PERIOD_GE_PRICE_PROVENANCE",
}
complete = {name: dict(before[symbol]) for name, symbol in fields.items()}
complete["buy_limit_source"] = before["PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMIT_SOURCE"]
roundtrip_path = ROOT / "tmp/review/grand-exchange-baseline-roundtrip.py"
write_generated(roundtrip_path, complete)
assert roundtrip_path.read_bytes() == before_bytes
for name in fields:
    assert set(qualified[name]) == keys
    assert not keys.intersection(complete[name])
    complete[name].update(qualified[name])
write_generated(output, complete)
after_bytes = output.read_bytes()
after = maps_from(after_bytes)
summary = {}
for name, symbol in fields.items():
    retained = {key: value for key, value in after[symbol].items() if key not in keys}
    assert retained == before[symbol]
    assert {key: after[symbol][key] for key in keys} == qualified[name]
    summary[symbol] = {
        "before_count": len(before[symbol]),
        "after_count": len(after[symbol]),
        "only_added_keys": sorted(keys),
        "all_preexisting_entries_identical": True,
    }
assert after["PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMIT_SOURCE"] == before["PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMIT_SOURCE"]
assert not any(name.startswith("ankiscape.core") for name in sys.modules)
proof = {
    "captured_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "source_baseline_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "cwd": str(ROOT),
    "command": "python3 tmp/review/generate_cut_gem_rows.py",
    "writer": "tools/generate_ge_period_data.py:278",
    "writer_file_sha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "tools/generate_ge_period_data.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "qualified_additions_path": str(source_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
    "qualified_additions_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "before_generated_sha256": hashlib.sha256(before_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "after_generated_sha256": hashlib.sha256(after_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "unchanged_map_roundtrip_was_byte_identical": True,
    "preserved_global_limit_source": after["PERIOD_GE_BUY_LIMIT_SOURCE"],
    "map_comparison": summary,
    "program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "scope": "Deterministic local generation only. No harvest, network request, or product behavioral test was run.",
}
(ROOT / "memory-bank/source-audits/cut-gem-tradeability-implementation-2026-09-05/generation-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"maps": summary, "generated_sha256": proof["after_generated_sha256"]}, indent=2))
